content:
jamie: Quick sync — I'm prototyping an 'autoswitch watchdog' for canary/A-B rollouts. Small local decision layer that can flip traffic on short signals instead of waiting for central adjudication. Pros/cons?

santosh: interesting. Pros: faster MTTR. Cons: more surface for accidental flips. Need very strict boundary rules for what locals can do.

maya: agree with santosh. We should define an explicit contract: local decisions = immediate safety responses only (latency/error), no unilateral quality-based switches without central approval. Must emit rationale + snapshot.

eli: metrics to consider: p95/p99 latency, error-rate (500s), token-generation failures, and model-quality deltas from automated evals. Policy DSL on rollout config looks sane.

oncall-bot: ALERT: autoswitch triggered for service "text-gen" — canary variant v2 rolled back to v1. reason: latency_p95 420ms (threshold 300ms) over 5m. event_id=evt-3276543210-1

jamie: sketch of config I had in mind: `autoswitch: { enabled: true, triggers: [{ metric: "latency_p95", op: ">", value: 300, duration: "5m" }], actions: ["switch","notify"] }`

maya: + add these fields: `lease_duration`, `safety_budget`, `suppress_window`, `manual_override`. sample:
```json
{
  "autoswitch": {
    "enabled": true,
    "lease_duration": "60s",
    "safety_budget": 0.02,
    "suppress_window": "2m",
    "triggers": [
      { "metric": "latency_p95", "op": ">", "value": 300, "duration": "5m" },
      { "metric": "error_rate", "op": ">", "value": 0.01, "duration": "3m" }
    ],
    "actions": ["switch","notify"],
    "manual_override": true
  }
}
```

santosh: edge cases: flapping during infra blips. add exponential backoff on re-enables and per-tenant opt-outs. Also ensure autoswitch respects capacity knobs (don't switch if fallback can't handle load).

eli: interface detail: local decisions must post to eventbus a structured `decision` event `{reason, metric_snapshot, confidence, model_hash}`. central controller can veto within a configurable window (e.g., 30s) to avoid split-brain.

maya: logging/audit must record model artifact hashes, tokenizer version, and rollout commit id so we can correlate regressions to exact build. No silent compatibility mismatches.

jamie: ops flow: any autoswitch should notify #eng-oncall, create incident stub with auto-filled fields, and provide a one-click rollback in Console. Also add a short runbook snippet in the incident. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-327654-01 — autoswitch v2->v1 triggered. assignees: @eli @santosh. notes: "Investigate p95 spike; check GPU queue depth and KV cache miss rate."

eli: next steps: I'll draft the decision event schema and veto API. maya/santosh can prototype config DSL. jamie will wire the oncall integration.

jamie: perfect — will open a short RFC with diagram + sample configs. thanks all.
